description: Per-sub-project DORA metrics for a monorepo, produced by the monorepo plugin. Deployments are attributed by CI job name, pull requests by label.

options.content:
## Monorepo Sub-Projects

Each **sub-project** is a logical project inside a single Git repository. Deployments are attributed by **CI job name**, pull requests by **label**. Only Deployment Frequency and Lead Time for Changes are available — Change Failure Rate and Time to Restore require incident data, which this plugin does not attribute.

panels.description: Number of successful production deployments per sub-project in the selected time range. A sub-project showing zero usually means its deployJobPattern matches no CI job.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sub_project AS 'Sub-Project', COUNT(DISTINCT cicd_deployment_id) AS 'Deployments'
FROM monorepo_subproject_deployments
WHERE result = 'SUCCESS'
  AND environment = 'PRODUCTION'
  AND ('${project:csv}' = '' OR project_name IN (${project:singlequote}))
  AND $__timeFilter(finished_date)
GROUP BY sub_project
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Deployment Count by Sub-Project

panels.description: Successful production deployments over time, one series per sub-project. This is the metric that a plain DevLake setup cannot separate: without attribution every sub-project shows the whole repository's deployment count.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  DATE(finished_date) AS time,
  sub_project AS metric,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cicd_deployment_id) AS value
FROM monorepo_subproject_deployments
WHERE result = 'SUCCESS'
  AND environment = 'PRODUCTION'
  AND ('${project:csv}' = '' OR project_name IN (${project:singlequote}))
  AND $__timeFilter(finished_date)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Deployment Frequency over Time

panels.description: Average change lead time per sub-project, broken into its stages. Coding, pickup and review come from DORA unchanged; the deploy leg is recomputed against this sub-project's own deployments. All values in hours.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  sub_project AS 'Sub-Project',
  COUNT(*) AS 'PRs',
  ROUND(AVG(coding_time) / 60, 1) AS 'Coding (h)',
  ROUND(AVG(pickup_time) / 60, 1) AS 'Pickup (h)',
  ROUND(AVG(review_time) / 60, 1) AS 'Review (h)',
  ROUND(AVG(deploy_time) / 60, 1) AS 'Deploy (h)',
  ROUND(AVG(cycle_time) / 60, 1) AS 'Cycle Time (h)'
FROM monorepo_subproject_pr_metrics
WHERE ('${project:csv}' = '' OR project_name IN (${project:singlequote}))
  AND $__timeFilter(pr_merged_date)
GROUP BY sub_project
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Change Lead Time Breakdown by Sub-Project

panels.description: Merged pull requests carrying none of the configured sub-project labels. These are invisible to every metric on this dashboard. A rising number means labelling discipline is slipping, not that the code is wrong.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS 'Unattributed merged PRs'
FROM pull_requests pr
JOIN project_mapping pm
  ON pm.table = 'repos' AND pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
LEFT JOIN monorepo_subproject_pr_metrics m
  ON m.pull_request_id = pr.id AND m.project_name = pm.project_name
WHERE pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL
  AND m.pull_request_id IS NULL
  AND ('${project:csv}' = '' OR pm.project_name IN (${project:singlequote}))
  AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)

panels.title: Unattributed PRs

panels.description: Merged pull requests that have been attributed to a sub-project but that no deployment has shipped yet, or whose shipping deployment could not be identified.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS 'Merged, not yet deployed'
FROM monorepo_subproject_pr_metrics
WHERE deployment_id = ''
  AND ('${project:csv}' = '' OR project_name IN (${project:singlequote}))
  AND $__timeFilter(pr_merged_date)

panels.title: Awaiting Deployment

panels.description: Every attributed deployment, newest first. The job name column shows which CI job caused the attribution — useful for checking a deployJobPattern is matching what you expect.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  finished_date AS 'Finished',
  sub_project AS 'Sub-Project',
  job_name AS 'CI Job',
  environment AS 'Environment',
  result AS 'Result',
  cicd_deployment_id AS 'Deployment',
  commit_sha AS 'Commit'
FROM monorepo_subproject_deployments
WHERE ('${project:csv}' = '' OR project_name IN (${project:singlequote}))
  AND $__timeFilter(finished_date)
ORDER BY finished_date DESC
LIMIT 200
